ordered_branches.explanation: Extracts warehouse/user from session XML through a helper but does not use either in the maximum lookup. Scalar SYSTEM_CONFIG_DETAIL lookup by fixed record type/key has no warehouse filter; multiple rows can fail. Privately inspected generated code compares trim(Form1.BASEQTY.value) > maximum, alerts, focuses the quantity and returns false. The procedure generates code; it does not itself validate a scanned quantity or prove browser execution. Receipt/item/company/lot/open quantity/preference/overreceiving inputs are unused.
